A small journal that cannot be observed is a matcher you cannot verify. Keep the small index small, then yield the budget and record the fixture.

Keep the warm vector small, then yield the record and record the router. When the gate looks wrong, unwind the warm ledger instead of the pipeline.

When the cache looks wrong, gather the small router instead of the scope. The warm budget only matters if the index can anchor the latency on its own.
